statement: ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → Even n → ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n ∧ 2*n ≤ 6*p ∧ |(p:ℤ)+(q:ℤ)-(n:ℤ)| ≤ 2

plain_statement.zh: 探索猜想：中心步长在三个相邻偶数中至少命中一个
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: a central step hits one of three consecutive even targets

brief.zh: 允许 n−2、n、n+2 三个目标。可尝试估计三点平滑卷积下界，或构造连续三处全漏的反例。第一步长限制在 [n/3,2n/3]。
brief.en: Allow n−2, n or n+2. Seek a uniform lower bound for a three-point smoothed convolution or a block of three misses. Restrict the first step to [n/3,2n/3].
